notes.title: Audio Remaster is here!
notes.content:
We've just published a substantial game update that includes sound-level fixes, and remastered dialogue audio for sharper and clearer sound quality. 

Audio Fixes
[list]
    [*]Fix for sound level issues
    [*]Remastered dialogue for sharper and clearer sound
    [*]Other audio errors corrected 
[/list]
Other Bug Fixes
[list]
    [*]The notorious 'Spotlight' bug is squashed
    [*]Fixed bug that would prevent True Detective and Limericks achievements unlocking
    [*]All unlockable comics and articles now available in the Extras section
    [*]Further game optimises and fixes
[/list]

tags.feature: [*]Remastered dialogue for sharper and clearer sound

tags.bug: [*]Fixed bug that would prevent True Detective and Limericks achievements unlocking

tags.feature: [*]All unlockable comics and articles now available in the Extras section

notes.title: Jennifer Wilde - Free Demo Update - Kickstarter Half Way point
notes.content:
Our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/outsidergames/jennifer-wilde-a-point-and-click-adventure-game/]Jennifer Wilde Kickstarter campaign[/url] has 14 days to go and we're 43% of the way to our funding goal.

[img]http://www.outsidergames.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/GIFInventoryWalking.gif[/img]

We've updated our free demo with a few tweaks and bug fixes. It's now available via our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/outsidergames/jennifer-wilde-a-point-and-click-adventure-game/]Kickstarter Page[/url], [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/JenniferWilde/285456]Gamejolt[/url] and [url=https://outsidergames.itch.io/jennifer-wilde]itch.io[/url] 

While still a work-in-progress, the demo has garnered some great feedback, and already won its first award at the Galway Games gathering for Excellence in Art!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/504/876/68baad1123b5546dc2ed541f6a8b0c6b_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1506530223&auto=format&lossless=true&s=3740631e46f2af3b08fc509266162b71[/img]

We need the support of Wailing Heights' players to fund our spiritual follow-up, so do please check out the  [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/outsidergames/jennifer-wilde-a-point-and-click-adventure-game/]campaign[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes 05.04.2016
notes.content:
Latest patch includes:

[*] Song Audio balancing - 'Make it Stick', 'Euphoria' volumes lowered to match surroundings
[*] Bug Fix - Finale now plays correct songs
[*] Easier to pick up [spoiler] Spotlight in Souless Saloon [/spoiler] 
[*] Bat can no longer fly through Town Hall ceiling
[*] Pre-selected dialogue text is no longer blurry at lower resolutions
[*] Other small big fixes.

Further dialogue audio level fixes to come.
